facts.fact: Jembi states that real-time digital birth registration was launched in July 2024 by connecting the hospital system MGDH-Birth to the civil registration system e-SiRCEV, with over 11,589 newborns registered in the pilot.

Jembi states that at Chicuque Rural Hospital health workers entered birth data directly into MGDH-Birth with instant confirmation in e-SiRCEV, through an interoperability layer, so that a newborn was registered without travel to a registry office.
Jembi calls the hospital birth registration link a pilot, expanded from 5 to 19 health facilities in Inhambane Province during 2024; no total of facilities or offices is given.

systems.tiers: receives births in real time from 19 health facilities in Inhambane Province (pilot, 2024)

systems.platform: linked to e-SiRCEV through OpenHIM, Jembi's interoperability layer
systems.tiers: health facilities in Inhambane Province, 5 rising to 19; health workers enter the birth data

note: The birth is entered by health workers in the hospital system, not by a registrar; the source calls the result birth registration, and the facts follow its wording.
